recipe.title: Devilled sausages
recipe.notes: This recipe is from Annabel Langbein's book, Essential Volume One.

i.n: onions, large, halved and thinly sliced
cayenne pepper, or more for grown-ups

method.s: Prick sausages and fan bake at 200 deg C until browned all over, about 20 minutes.
Heat oil in a large pot. add onions and sauté over low heat until very soft and starting to brown, about 12 minutes.
Stir in all other ingredients except sausages and simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Add browned sausages and simmer another 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasonings if needed. Serve hot.
